result.topic_en: Notes on the wave equations for aether displacements: the equations derived for a single wave also hold for superposed waves through a point, because the Laplacian is invariant under rectangular coordinate transformations; the total motion is the sum of the partial motions, and differentiating with respect to time gives the same equations for the velocity components.
